name: G5RV Antenna
description: The G5RV is a classic multiband HF antenna consisting of a 102-foot dipole fed with a 34-foot section of ladder line that acts as an impedance transformer. With a tuner, it provides coverage from 80m through 10m.
modelingNotes: The 34 ft ladder-line section acts as a matching transformer.
Coax feedline losses increase significantly on bands with high SWR.
Height above ground strongly affects performance on 80m and 40m.
The antenna can be installed as horizontal, inverted-V, or sloper.
A tuner is required for most bands except near 20m resonance.
The design originates from Louis Varney (G5RV) in 1946.
